definitions.explanation: A piece of land that projects out into water, connected to the mainland on one side and surrounded by water on the other sides.

examples.japanese: {半島|はんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{灯台|とうだい}→灯台：04560_toudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a lighthouse at the tip of the peninsula.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伊豆|いず}→伊豆：noentry⟧{半島|はんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The Izu Peninsula is famous for its hot springs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝鮮|ちょうせん}→朝鮮：noentry⟧{半島|はんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: The Korean Peninsula is divided into two countries.

notes:
USAGE: {半島|はんとう} combines ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) and ⟦{島|とう}→島：00885_shima⟧ (island), describing land that is partially surrounded by water.
